title: Resolvable citation on a tool result
description: Canonical shape for the source identity the platform mints for every knowledge record and every assertable tool result, and that the console renders. Canonical home: oraclous-knowledge interface-contracts §CITE (rev3). The root schema is a Citation; SourceRef (what a connector emits inbound) is in $defs. additionalProperties is false at every level, so no locator, no chunk index and no caller-smuggled field can ever exist. A citation resolves to a DOCUMENT VERSION and nothing finer (rev3).

Citation.title: Citation
Citation.description: The resolvable source identity of one knowledge record. Minted by platform code only — a model may reference a citation_id, it may never author one.

citation_id.description: Platform-computed, deterministic: 'cit_' + sha256(source_system ‖ 0x00 ‖ source_id ‖ 0x00 ‖ revision)[:32], where ‖ 0x00 ‖ is a NUL byte. The ONLY handle an answer may cite.

source_system.description: A REGISTERED connector slug, plus the reserved value 'upload' for a direct file upload. Deliberately NOT a closed enum: UC-E1 acceptance 6 requires a sixth, unplanned source type to be connectable without re-modelling existing records. That the value names a registered connector is a runtime check, not a schema one.

source_id.description: Identity WITHIN that system, stable across revisions (e.g. 'owner/repo:path', a canonical URL, an ingest job id).

revision.description: The version read. NEVER null, on any path: when a source exposes no version of its own the platform falls back to the SHA-256 of the content it holds, with revision_kind 'content_hash'. Required and non-nullable so both the identity hash and the supersession rule stay total.

revision_kind.description: What kind of version 'revision' is — a source-native version, or our own content-hash fallback. This is what tells the two apart.

url.description: Absolute and openable. Null only when the platform genuinely cannot resolve the source: today that is the 'upload' path, because no route serves an uploaded document back yet.

title.description: Display label ONLY — never identity. Null when the source exposes no title.

author.description: The SOURCE's author. Null when the system exposes none — many do not.

retrieved_at.description: As-of: when this revision was read from the source. Platform-computed, never inbound.

permission_ref.description: The source's own permission handle. CARRIED now, UNENFORCED until per-user permission mirroring lands — that is the entire point of it being in the shape already.

SourceRef.title: SourceRef
SourceRef.description: What a CONNECTOR emits alongside the content it read, and the only citation-shaped thing that may travel inbound. 'revision'/'revision_kind' are optional inbound (the platform falls back to a content hash); citation_id and retrieved_at are absent by construction — they are platform-computed, so additionalProperties:false makes a caller-supplied citation_id unrepresentable here.

Author.title: Author
Author.description: The source record's author, as the source exposes them.

source_handle.description: The handle within the source system. Omitted when the system exposes none.

email.description: Optional; omitted unless the source exposes it.
